app.name: Tunnel
app.tagline: Send anything between your devices with a one-time code.

welcome.title: Welcome to Tunnel
welcome.intro: Link two devices with a short code and send files, folders and text of any size. No account, nothing stored on a server.
welcome.device_name_hint: The other person sees this name when you connect.
welcome.save_folder: Where to save what you receive
welcome.firewall: Your computer may ask to let Tunnel use the network. Allow it on private networks so devices on the same Wi-Fi can find each other directly.

home.title: What would you like to do?
home.show_text: This device shows a code. Type it on the other device.
home.enter_text: The other device shows a code. Type it here.
home.how_1: One device shows a code, the other types it.
home.how_2: Both screens show the same 6-digit safety code. You both confirm it.
home.how_3: Drop files in either direction. The receiver accepts each transfer.
home.no_recent: Nothing yet. Your transfers will appear here.

show.title: Type this code on the other device
show.once: A code works once and expires after 10 minutes.
show.qr_alt: QR code for the phone app
show.qr_hint: For the Tunnel phone app, when it arrives

enter.title: Enter the code from the other device
enter.label: Connection code
enter.hint: Any spacing or capitals work. Three letters of each word are enough.
enter.other_host_text: This link uses the pairing service at {{host}}, which is not the one in your settings. Only continue if you trust where the link came from.

connecting.title: Connecting
connecting.hint: This usually takes a few seconds.

safety.title: Check the safety code
safety.intro: Make sure the other device shows the same number.
safety.waiting_peer: Waiting for the other person to confirm…
safety.why: If the numbers differ, someone else may have used your code. Nothing can be sent until you both confirm.

session.direct_hint: Data travels straight between the two devices.
session.relay_hint: Connected through a relay. Transfers may be slower.
session.end_confirm_text: Transfers that are still running will stop.
session.text_placeholder: Type a message or paste a link
session.feed_empty: Nothing sent yet. Either side can send.
session.blocked: An unsafe transfer from {{name}} was blocked. Nothing was saved.
session.open_link_text: Links never open on their own. Check the address before you copy it into your browser.

offer.title: {{name}} wants to send you
offer.shortfall: Not enough space. Free up {{size}} or choose another folder.
offer.warn_executables_one: Contains {{count}} program or script. Only open it if you trust the sender.
offer.warn_executables_other: Contains {{count}} programs or scripts. Only open them if you trust the sender.
offer.warn_double_extensions_one: {{count}} file hides a program behind another extension, like report.pdf.exe.
offer.warn_double_extensions_other: {{count}} files hide a program behind another extension, like report.pdf.exe.
offer.warn_bidi_names_one: {{count}} name contains hidden text-direction characters and may not be what it seems.
offer.warn_bidi_names_other: {{count}} names contain hidden text-direction characters and may not be what they seem.
offer.warn_renamed_one: {{count}} name will be changed to be safe on this device.
offer.warn_renamed_other: {{count}} names will be changed to be safe on this device.
offer.warn_low_space: This will use most of the free space in that folder.

transfer.state_offered: Waiting for the other device to accept…
transfer.paused_disk_full: Paused: this device is out of space. Free some up, then resume.
transfer.items_truncated: Only the first items are listed.

reason.link: It is a link. Links are not followed.
reason.special_file: It is not a regular file.
reason.unreadable_on_sender: It couldn't be read on the other device.
reason.changed: It changed while sending. Send it again.
reason.exists: A file with this name already exists.
reason.kept_both: A file with this name already existed, so both were kept.
reason.refused: The other device wouldn't send it.
reason.protocol: The other device sent something unexpected.
reason.destination_link: A link sits where its folder should be. It was not followed.
reason.destination_file: A file sits where its folder should be.
reason.path_too_long: The path is too long for this device.
reason.unsafe_name: Its name was changed to be safe on this device.

ended.title_peer: The other device ended the session
ended.text_local: Everything that finished is saved. Nothing is kept on any server.

history.title: History
history.off: History is turned off in Settings.
history.clear_confirm: Clear all history? This can't be undone.
history.kept: Kept for {{period}}. Stored only on this device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notifications_hint: For offers and finished transfers when the window is in the background.
settings.ask_where: Ask where to save each time
settings.mark_downloaded_hint: Your computer then warns before a received program runs.
settings.pairing_note: Devices find each other through the relay network using the number at the start of the code. No pairing server is needed, and the code words never leave your devices.
settings.rendezvous_hint: Leave empty to pair without a server. If you run your own, it starts with wss:// and both devices must use the same one.
settings.relays_hint: One per line. Leave empty to use the default relays.
settings.max_entries: Most files accepted in one transfer
settings.debug_hint: Only for troubleshooting. Logs normally leave out names, paths, codes and keys.
settings.privacy_note: No accounts, no analytics, no automatic crash reports. Servers see IP addresses briefly to limit abuse and never see codes or files.
settings.credits: The code words come from the EFF Short Wordlist #2 (Electronic Frontier Foundation, CC BY 3.0 US). Connections use iroh. Built with Tauri and Rust.

error.code_invalid: That doesn't look like a code. A code looks like 4821-orbit-velvet-candle.
error.code_failed: That code didn't work. Codes work once, so ask for a new one.
error.code_expired: This code expired. Make a new one.
error.code_not_found: No device is showing that code right now. Check the number, or ask for a new code.
error.code_in_use: Someone already used this code. If it wasn't your friend, end the session and start over.
error.rendezvous_unreachable: Can't reach the pairing network. Check your internet connection.
error.rendezvous_busy: The pairing service is busy. Wait a minute and try again.
error.rendezvous_address_invalid: The pairing service address isn't valid. Check Settings > Advanced.
error.peer_unreachable: Couldn't connect to the other device. A firewall may be blocking the connection.
error.version_mismatch: The other device needs an update. Update both to the latest Tunnel.
error.bind_failed: The connection could not be verified, so it was closed. Start over with a new code.
error.safety_mismatch: The safety codes didn't match, so the session was ended. Start over with a new code.
error.peer_ended: The other device ended the session.
error.protocol: The other device sent something unexpected, so the session was closed.
error.session_busy: A session is already open. End it before starting another.
error.no_session: There is no open session for that.
error.unknown_transfer: That transfer is no longer available.
error.no_space: Not enough space. Free up {{size}} or choose another folder.
error.destination_not_writable: Can't save to that folder. Choose another one.
error.too_many_transfers: Too many transfers are running. Wait for one to finish.
error.nothing_to_send: There is nothing to send in that selection.
error.too_many_entries: That selection has too many files for one transfer.
error.text_too_long: That text is too long to send as a message. Send it as a file instead.
error.declined_invalid: The other device could not accept this selection.
error.declined_busy: The other device has too many transfers waiting. Try again in a moment.
error.declined_no_space: The other device does not have enough free space.
